scripts.install-deps: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')){ execSync('npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); } else { execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); }"
